contract: five uint32 input words (20 bytes), address/valid uint32 output (8 bytes); invalid={0,0}; synchronous CPU-readable caller-owned output; maximum 1048576; no overlapping spans
cpu_baseline: verified inline batch; compare scalar pilot and retain it; if scalar is faster, resolve before official trials
workloads: 0/1/31/33 mixed valid PSM0/19 at TBP16320 TBW3 x=i%64 y=i/64; 4096/16384/143360/1048576 each separately PSM0 and PSM19, synthetic rectangles width64/128/640/1024 TBP16320 TBW=width/64; 356160 retained mixed GADR corpus
timing: steady_clock around one complete call; CPU preallocated caller output, GPU preallocated shared staging and output buffers plus caller output; GPU staging, encode, submit, wait, status and output memcpy charged; validation/full output consumption outside timing symmetrically
ordering: CPU then GPU on even sample+trial, GPU then CPU on odd; trial0 starts CPU; independent process per trial
cold: CPU caller allocation and Metal factory/device/library/pipeline/max-capacity buffers plus first full-capacity execution reported separately
gpu_threadgroup: primary min(256,pipeline max), execution-width aligned; no refinement selected

success.aggregate: median of five per-trial median CPU / median GPU e2e ratios

exclusions: retain all trials; exclude an entire trial on observed user interaction, thermal warning, build/profiler/VM or heavy worker overlap; explain reason, rerun same trial index; no exclusion solely for unfavorable latency. Preflight: ten seconds HID input idle, no other observed process at >=50% CPU, no known build/VM/profiler. Before/after HID reset or those load conditions invalidate the trial. Snapshot monitoring cannot rule out every short transient; the primary also checks live jobs.
scope: address-only; synthetic throughput not observed gameplay distribution, loading or FPS; host sanitizers do not establish GPU memory safety
